rationale: Shiza's work at the intersection of robotics, haptics, and applied ML—combined with her conviction that custom ML deployment now requires only curiosity and determination—aligns with Ming's philosophy that trust and verifiable computation are becoming programmable primitives. While Ming's expertise in zero-knowledge cryptography and universal virtual machines operates in a different domain, his emphasis on building interoperability layers and his deep systems architecture background (MIPS chip design, aerospace) could offer fresh perspectives on how robotics systems might incorporate verifiable computation and trust mechanisms at scale.
intro_message: Shiza Charania, meet Ming Guo — a systems architect and cryptographer exploring how verifiable computation could underpin the next generation of robotics and AI systems.
